criteria.text: After pairing to the same Mac and selecting the same project/user, mobile and desktop list the same eligible existing sessions.
criteria.test_id: issue-1231-c1: desktop-created session is visible through the paired mobile gateway

criteria.text: A session created on mobile appears on desktop, and a session created on desktop appears on mobile, through realtime delivery or a bounded authoritative refresh.
criteria.test_id: issue-1231-c2: creation through either surface converges through bounded refresh

criteria.text: Rename, archive/restore, and delete state converge across both clients.
criteria.test_id: issue-1231-c3: mobile lifecycle mutations reconcile into the desktop catalog

criteria.text: Session identity remains stable across refresh/reconnect; no duplicate rows or transcript messages are introduced.
criteria.test_id: issue-1231-c4: repeated authoritative refresh preserves one local identity

criteria.text: Project and user ownership filtering remains server-side and fail-closed.
criteria.test_id: issue-1231-c5: ownership rejects cross-user and cross-project access

criteria.text: Offline mobile cache is secret-free, clearly marked stale/read-only, and reconciles on reconnect.
criteria.test_id: issue-1231-c6: offline cache is sanitized read-only and replaced on reconnect

criteria.text: Automated coverage exercises two clients against the same gateway, and a physical-device smoke confirms cross-device visibility.
criteria.reason: Automated two-surface coverage is authored in the live E2E, but the required physical iPhone plus desktop smoke needs human hardware.
